# How long the harness module's slow tests take on a GitHub runner (4 vCPU,
# go test -race, the default MIMICRY_PROFILES), in seconds, and the tier
# each test runs in. Read by .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh to pick a CI
# run's tests and split them into shards; a test not listed counts as 2
# seconds, tier core. Taken from the runner's logs (each shard's log has
# every test's --- PASS line with its duration, and its === RUN line; for a
# test whose subtests are parallel the --- PASS line says 0.00s, so its time
# is from === RUN to --- PASS). The parallel tests (HTTP/3, the edge
# scenarios) are bound by -parallel, which is the runner's 4 CPUs: they take
# about the sum of their subtests over 4, far longer than on a many-core Mac.
#
# Tiers (.github/workflows/ci.yml picks them):
#   core      every pull request that touches code, and main
#   protocol  pull requests touching the HTTP/2, HTTP/3, QUIC or engine code
#             (the protocol paths in ci.yml), and main
#   gen       pull requests touching the generators, captures, profile data
#             or capture parsing (the gen paths in ci.yml), and main
#   main      pushes to main, the nightly run, workflow_dispatch and release
#             only: a regression here shows after the merge
# A new test lands in core, so it runs on every pull request until it is
# given a line here.
#
# A slow test needs a line here, or the shard it lands in can run past the
# 15-minute limit: `bash .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh all plan 7` prints
# main's split, `... core,protocol plan 5` a pull request's (ci.yml has each
# tier's shard count). `Test/regex` runs a slice of a test's subtests as its
# own unit (a test whose subtests alone take longer than a shard should);
# the subtests no slice matches run as one more unit. A test's lines share
# one tier. `TestA|TestB` (tier -) keeps tests in one unit when the run's
# tiers include them all; its members' own lines give their tiers, and their
# weights when they run apart.
#
# seconds  tier      package          test[/subtests]
130        gen       ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^chrome-.*-macos
165        gen       ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^chrome-.*-windows
145        gen       ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^firefox-
90         gen       ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^safari-
100        gen       ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
100        gen       ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles
20         gen       ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
25         gen       ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles
5          gen       ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
# 48 subtests of about 50 s, 12 per profile: a profile's take about 300 s
# on a 4-CPU Linux box, about 1200 s whole, so a slice per profile.
290        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^chrome-.*-macos
305        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^chrome-.*-windows
305        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^firefox-
290        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^safari-
65         main      ./e2e            TestQUICInterop
# Both replay every page capture, decoded once per test binary (pagesOnce,
# nearly all of their time): apart, each decodes them.
210        -         ./e2e            TestChainedPrioritiesMatchBrowserTraces|TestHPACKReproducesBrowserBlocks
200        protocol  ./e2e            TestChainedPrioritiesMatchBrowserTraces
200        core      ./e2e            TestHPACKReproducesBrowserBlocks
250        protocol  ./e2e            TestConnectionMatchesBrowserTrace
135        protocol  ./e2e            TestHTTP3DownloadMatchesBrowser
125        protocol  ./e2e            TestHTTP3MatchesBrowser
35         protocol  ./e2e            TestHTTP3ACKEvery
120        core      ./e2e            TestInheritedProfile
80         core      ./e2e            TestWebSocketsMatchBrowser
15         core      ./e2e            TestConnectionsMatchBrowser
15         core      ./e2e            TestCORSMatchesBrowser
10         core      ./e2e            TestDeflateReproducesBrowserMessages
10         core      ./e2e            TestNavRedirectsMatchBrowser
6          core      ./e2e            TestResumptionMatchesBrowser
5          core      ./e2e            TestRedirects2MatchesBrowser
